IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Wednesday, September 16, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA**
Sixty calls, four-hundred-twenty-one hands deep—this board is moving. Miller Electrical, Inglett & Stubbs, and Whitehead Electric are all running data center work at QTS Fayetteville and the Hampton shop on **$42/hr**, split between 4-10's and mixed 2-8 schedules starting 6 or 6:30am. Hanging cable work mixed in. Tight crew requests but solid volume if you're ready to lock in 50+ hours a week.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI**
Port Washington data center is eating hours. Cupertino and Gurtz are both deep-hiring Inside JW's at **JW wage plus $10/hr**, running 58–60 hour weeks with a Wisconsin license requirement. That's real overscale money for a Midwest board. Pieper's reposting service truck work with foreman pay for the driver. Book's at two-hundred-seven hands—not a lock, but moving steady.

**LU-430 Racine, WI**
Microsoft Mount Pleasant is the anchor: Gerdes, Pieper, Staff Electric, and Kelso Burnett all hiring at **$62.51/hr**. That's the highest single-call rate on the board. Reciprocal card holders welcome; long sleeves and safety gear mandatory. Eleven calls total, seventy-six hands—this is a tight local running tight schedules.

**LU-354 Salt Lake City, UT**
Twenty-five calls, one-thirty in the book. Cache Valley's got twenty-five Inside JW slots at P&G Corrine on **$46.22/hr**, 6-10's possibly stretching to 12's. Winward's offering **$225/hr per diem incentive** on each 10-hour day with Saturday OT. Rocky Mountain Power and Meta also staffing at scale. Solid work, decent money, clear book.

**LU-575 Portsmouth, OH**
TSG is mobilizing ninety-seven hands to Amazon North Campus starting Monday, September 21—4-10 schedule. Blattner's got nine more on Palomino Solar at 5-8's. This board's thin (four calls, one-oh-nine hands), but it's *live* and it's *now*. 

Data center work and solar are absorbing hands nationwide—chase the megaproject starts or get left flat.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Wednesday, September 16, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running the board hard: 46 calls, 140 hands needed. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is the anchor, hiring 40 JL's for Columbus distribution work at $125/day per diem plus $125 bonus on a 10hr day, 6-10s with a CDL requirement. Their southern Ohio crew (9 JL's) runs 4-10s with optional weekend extensions. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS is splicing cable work near Johnstown if you've got OSHA 10 and barehand experience. Solid distro board with depth.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — 42 calls, 135 hands. SERVICE ELECTRIC is stacking two large calls at **$56.8/hr** for Social Circle JL's with Quanta barehand cert required and **+$10/hr over Local**; **$150/day per diem**. That's the money play here. HEART UTILITIES runs northeast Georgia at **$46.8/hr** on 4-10s. Deep board, premium pay, barehand cert is the gate.

**LU-66 Houston, TX** has 18 calls spread across NHPL's transmission and distribution—Floresville transmission pays **$175/day per diem**; Houston overhead distro and surrounding areas both at **$150/day**. All Class A CDL required. Front Line's URD transformer inspections (9 JL's) take Class C only but run no per diem. Tight board, transmission work dominates.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** — 41 calls, 65 hands. MJ Electric's Winamac transmission job (345kv, 4 JL's) sits at the top: **$67.18/hr**, **$105/day per diem**. Kent Power's Valparaiso distro work runs **$56.66/hr** at **$125/day**. ARC American's 12.5k rebuilds pay **$64.66/hr**. Transmission work is where the premium sits; book is shallow.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — 25 calls, 65 hands. Parsons Electric dominates with 28 Inside JW slots at the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood: **$44.8/hr** base, **$100/day non-taxed per diem**, plus incentive pay (**$100 Mon-Fri, $150 Sat/Sun** on the second call). Open calls, ND license, drug test. Data center build is the driver.

Data-center construction and transmission rebuilds are pulling hands nationwide; locals with deep boards and specialty certs (barehand, nuclear clearance, transmission) are clearing Book 1 faster than typical storm work cycles.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Wednesday, September 16, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is the board to watch right now — 23 calls, 47 hands needed, almost all Intel Ronler Acres work in Hillsboro. Apollo Mechanical's running 8 CAD/BIM detailer slots; Charter's got 5 fitter calls plus 4 high-purity specialists and 3 orbital welder spots across tool install. It's semi-conductor backbone work — steady, organized, good crew depth. No posted rates, but the sheer volume and contractor lineup signal solid work.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** stays thick — 18 calls, 61 hands. BCS Mechanical dominates: 15 journeyman pipefitters and 13 plumbers on the Sego Project, West Valley, all 4-10s starting Aug 3, overtime built in. DSI's got 6 pipefitter slots at QTS in Eagle Mountain on a tighter 5-8 schedule with **$10.00** on that call. Five apprentice spots round it out. Steady industrial work, long hours, predictable.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** — 14 calls, 47 hands — skews toward specialized fab and high-purity. Kiewit's CWI position hits **$65.00** per diem and **$65** shift premium on 5/10s + Sat nights (15% bonus). US Eng. Metalworks needs SS TIG welders and fitters in-shop; US Eng. Construction's Broadcom Fort Collins call wants tube-bending experience. Murphy's Coors 4-can filler needs schedule-5/10 stainless welders. Specialty credentials matter here — pays better if you've got the ticket.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** — 5 calls, 26 hands — refinery and data center backbone. Gem's fab shop wants 5 combo welders (test required); Graham's Cenovus maintenance needs 4 pipefitters on 6-10s with spotty OT; Nooter's Cenovus run adds 5 more pipefitters, 7-10s, **$125/day** per diem. Upland's Lima Data Center offers 2 pipefitter slots with OT paid at double-time rates. Heavy industrial, current card mandatory on some slots.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is thin — 1 call, 12 hands — but it's Four Seasons towers, Henderson, 12 journeyman slots starting Thursday 7/30. OSHA 10/30 card required. Call the hall for rates.

High-purity semiconductor and refinery maintenance are pulling hands West and South; data centers are steady fillers.
